rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_supervised-claude-agentic: proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=7, proj_kernel=3, proj_sx=0.01, proj_sy=0.3, proj_sr=0.0005, img_kernel=7, img_sx=0.5, img_sy=0.5, img_sr=0.02, epochs=10, batch_size=1, lr=0.01, optimizer=adam, lambda_neg=0.1, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=400, val_n=200, val_chunk=10, seed=42, rationale=iter-9 dual_domain_bilateral_supervised, re-split Breast-CT val=200. SIX-BOX vs BEST (iter-6 lr=1e-2/img_sr0.02/lneg1.0 hr=0.2555). (1) PRIOR: img_sr init widening HURT (iter-8 img_sr0.05=0.2493) -> trainable sigma finds its own optimum, reverted to 0.02; lr bracketed at 1e-2. (2) Failure mode: lambda_neg=1.0 may over-suppress the low-mu breast background, biasing the L2 fit away from true attenuation (the sibling DD-UNet gained by lowering it 1.0->0.03). (3) ONE KNOB: lambda_neg 1.0 -> 0.1 (best config otherwise). (4) HYPOTHESIS: lowering the negativity-penalty weight lets the supervised L2 term dominate and fit breast attenuation more faithfully -> hr above 0.2555 toward ~0.26; if hr DROPS, the penalty is load-bearing for the BF (which cannot clamp negatives itself) and iter-10 reverts to 1.0 and pivots to proj-side BF (proj_n_bf). (5) BUDGET: same ep10 -> ~120s. (6) Loop continues to iter-20. Artifacts saved.
